run_main_teleop: run the curses-based keyboard teleop loop to control a Spot robot arm and base
run_move_to_initial: run move_to_initial to position the Spot robot gripper to a predefined initial pose
run_cement_arm_joints: run cement_arm_joints to lock the Spot robot arm joints at their current positions
run_rotate: run rotate to spin the Spot robot in place while capturing sensor data
run_raise_error: run raise_error as a signal handler that raises RuntimeError on SIGINT
